top_signals.title: Copper Rally Fades as Demand Worries Deepen
top_signals.summary: Copper erased a one-day gain sparked by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp. Prices tumbled back toward the $12,000-a-ton level in London. Bloomberg's Mark Cranfield breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)
